description:
Adds modern roads.

You can build realistic and good-looking streets, roads and highways in your Luanti world. Guide the traffic with arrows and trafficlight and warn the world about dangerous situations with eye-catching signs!
Need to do some roadworks? Go ahead and style your construction area with detours, construction fences and yellow road labels. Be careful! Don't fall into the manhole!
Bring some light to your roads with delineators and streetlamps.
